result.name: darty
result.description: Read-only Korean DART disclosure search and retrieval CLI.

operations.name: search-company
operations.summary: Resolve a company name to an 8-digit DART company code.

operations.name: search-company-reports
operations.summary: List filings for one DART company code and date window.

operations.name: search-body
operations.summary: Search submitted filing body text by keyword.

operations.name: view-report
operations.summary: Fetch a filing TOC or a selected report section.

operations.name: disclosure-types
operations.summary: Find DART detailed disclosure-type filter codes.

operations.name: company-rss
operations.summary: Fetch a company-specific DART disclosure RSS feed.

operations.name: report-guide
operations.summary: Print a Markdown guide to report families.

warnings.message: Darty reads public DART web pages in read-only mode; it is not the official OpenDART API.
Check returned source references before using results for important decisions.

help: Run darty --help for full human-readable command help.
Then search filings: darty search-company-reports --company-code 00126380 --start-date YYYYMMDD --end-date YYYYMMDD --agent
Then inspect a filing: darty view-report --receipt <receiptNumber-or-viewerUrl>
